mapper.sql: select ttaskwcsdetail.id, ttaskwcsdetail.task_id, ttaskwcsdetail.type, ttaskwcsdetail.origin_id from t_task_wcs_detail ttaskwcsdetail
mapper.delete: update t_task_wcs_detail set del_flag = '1' where id = #{id}
update t_task_wcs_detail set del_flag = '1' where task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: select a.id , a.task_status , b.task_id, b.`type` as taskType, b.origin_id from t_task_wcs a left join t_task_wcs_detail b on a.id = b.task_id where a.tray_id = #{trayId} and b.`type` = #{taskType} and a.task_status = '1'

mapper.select:
select a.id ,a.origin_id, b.material_id ,
b.batch_code ,b.advance_registration_id, b.location_id,
tl.name as locationName , ts.batch_code , tr.name as reservoirName,
b.predict_count ,b.batch_number as batchCode,b.location_id,b.org_location_id,b.tray_id,
b.actual_count, m.code as materialCode, m.name as materialName, tu.name as unitName, tt.code as trayCode from t_task_wcs_detail a
left join t_task_in b on a.origin_id = b.id and a.`type` = '1'
left join t_task_out b on a.origin_id = b.id and a.`type` = '2' left join t_location tl on b.location_id = tl.id left join t_reservoir tr on tl.reservoir_id = tr.id left join t_stock ts on b.stock_id = ts.id
left join t_task_detail b on a.origin_id = b.id and a.`type` = '5'
left join t_material m on b.material_id = m.id left join t_unit tu on m.unit_id = tu.id left join t_tray tt on b.tray_id = tt.id where a.task_id = #{taskId}

SELECT ttwd.id, tm.`name` as materialName,tm.`code` as materialCode,tu.`name` as unitName,ttd.predict_count,ttd.batch_number as batchCode ,ttd.material_id,ttd.task_id,ttd.actual_count FROM t_task_wcs_detail ttwd JOIN t_task_detail ttd on ttd.id=ttwd.origin_id AND ttd.del_flag='0' JOIN t_material tm on tm.id=ttd.material_id and tm.del_flag='0' JOIN t_unit tu on tu.id=tm.unit_id WHERE ttwd.type='5' AND ttwd.del_flag='0' AND ttwd.task_id=#{taskwcsId} ORDER BY ttwd.create_time DESC

select d.id, d.status, d.complete_state from t_task_wcs_detail a left join t_task_in b on a.origin_id = b.id left join t_advance_delivery_detail c on b.advance_registration_id = c.id left join t_advance_delivery d on c.advance_delivery_id = d.id where a.task_id = #{taskId} and a.del_flag = '0' and b.del_flag = '0' and c.del_flag = '0' and d.del_flag = '0'

select a.id, a.tray_id, c.advance_registration_id , c.material_id, c.actual_count, c.batch_code, m.name as materialName from t_task_wcs a left join t_task_wcs_detail b on a.id = b.task_id left join t_task_in c on b.origin_id = c.id left join t_material m on c.material_id = m.id where a.del_flag = '0' and a.task_type = '1' and a.task_status = '1' and b.del_flag = '0' and a.tray_id = #{trayId}
